meta.title: Indica — referral infrastructure for SaaS
meta.description: Track every click, conversion and recurring commission without building affiliate infrastructure yourself.

home.headline: Turn referrals into a growth channel.
home.subhead: Track every click, conversion and recurring commission without building affiliate infrastructure yourself. Connect billing, choose a commission, install one snippet — then invite affiliates and watch the ledger fill in.

attribution.title: Attribution that holds up
attribution.body: First-click or last-click, a configurable window, and a deterministic resolver that is unit-tested against every edge case — including the one where two affiliates claim the same visitor.

ledger.title: A ledger, not a counter
ledger.body: Every commission records the rule that produced it. Refunds create a reversal instead of deleting history, so your numbers still reconcile six months later.

rails.title: You keep the money rails
rails.body: Indica never touches a payment. It tells you exactly what you owe and to whom; you pay through Wise, Pix, PayPal or a bank transfer and mark the batch as paid.

steps.title: Four steps, then it runs itself.
steps.subtitle: Most founders are live the same afternoon. Nothing here requires a migration or a contract.

connect.title: Connect billing
connect.body: Point your Stripe webhook at Indica. We read payment events; we never hold your keys.

commission.title: Choose a commission
commission.body: 30% for 12 months, a flat fee, or a custom rate for your best partner.

tracking.title: Install tracking
tracking.body: One script tag sets a first-party cookie and reports the referral code.

invite.title: Invite affiliates
invite.body: They get a link and a portal. You get a ledger and a payout list.

closing.title: The simplest way to put a referral program live.
closing.body: Connect billing, choose a commission, install tracking, invite affiliates. Done.

chrome.footer: Indica is the source of truth for your commissions. You keep paying affiliates your way.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Set up an affiliate program in a few minutes.

pricing.title: Priced like a tool, not a tax.
pricing.subtitle: We do not take a percentage of your affiliate revenue, because we never touch the money. You pay for the infrastructure and keep the upside.

starter.name: Starter
starter.description: Everything you need to run one program and prove the channel works.

growth.name: Growth
growth.description: For a program that is already producing revenue you care about.

scale.name: Scale
scale.description: Multiple products, a partnerships hire, and reporting people rely on.

docs.title: Integration guide
docs.subtitle: Four steps between a fresh workspace and a working referral program.

install.title: Install the tracker
install.body: Paste the snippet before </head> on the site your affiliates link to. It reads ?ref= from the URL, sets a first-party cookie called _referral_id (SameSite=Lax, one year) and posts the click to Indica.

identify.title: Identify the customer
identify.body: A click alone proves nothing. When someone signs up, call identify from YOUR SERVER with your secret key. Never from the browser: a customer id posted by a browser could be used to reassign commissions.

webhook.title: Point your webhook at Indica
webhook.body: Add the endpoint in Stripe and subscribe to invoice.payment_succeeded, charge.refunded, charge.dispute.created, customer.subscription.updated and customer.subscription.deleted. Every event is verified, then claimed exactly once, so a redelivery can never create a second commission.

commission.title: Read the commission
commission.body: When Stripe confirms $49.00 on a 30% program, Indica writes a commission of $14.70 against the affiliate that owns the attribution, holds it for the program's hold period, and then makes it payable. A refund adds a −$14.70 reversal and marks the original reversed; nothing is ever deleted.
